iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: MNI space as provided by the data authors: electrodes were localised with FieldTrip by co-registering pre-operative MRI and post-operative CT, manually selected, and warped into MNI space (Peterson et al. 2022; Stolk et al. 2018). The exact MNI template is not stated, so no template label is asserted. Values copied from the NWB electrodes table x/y/z.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: FieldTrip co-registration of pre-op MRI and post-op CT, warped to MNI (source: Peterson et al. 2022)
